stories.title: Miami climbs to 1, BYU to 2 after chaotic week shakes up AP poll
stories.summary: Miami climbed to the No. 1 spot in the AP Top 25 for the first time since 2002 while BYU's No. 2 ranking is its highest since 1984.

stories.title: Big 12 admits error in Notre Dame-BYU ending, says Irish had 1 second left
stories.summary: The Big 12 said officials incorrectly ended Saturday night's game between BYU and Notre Dame and that the Irish should have had another second on the clock to run a final play.

stories.title: NFL says Steelers-Saints in Paris still on despite civil unrest in France
stories.summary: The Week 7 game between the New Orleans Saints and Pittsburgh Steelers on Oct. 25 in Paris is still scheduled as planned despite civil unrest and protests in France, the NFL said.

stories.title: Man United situation 'doesn't look great' after latest draw, manager says
stories.summary: Michael Carrick said Manchester United's situation "doesn't look great" after a 1-1 draw at Leeds left the club in the bottom half of the Premier League.

stories.title: Miami survives two Hail Marys, leaving FSU without answers in 2OT thriller
stories.summary: Miami withstood a pair of Hail Mary attempts from Florida State to come away with a 43-35, double-overtime win and a likely move to No. 1 in the AP Top 25.
